Before a productive hallB visit, at most three accepted components occupy/reserve ASM input and one occupies QA output. Inbound moves reserve destination capacity. The first productive B visit must weld before any flange can return A for wash/QA, so it cannot assemble a pump. Thus n+1 B visits, each returning A before final QA. Under automatic prefix assumptions, only the first outward walk may overlap the initial prefix.
